description_en:
Description: A large shrub, up to 15 feet in height. The branches are thorny. The oval shaped leaves alternate arranged, 2–4 inches long, dark green, smooth and pale on the underside. The small flowers with five, white petals and yelow tipped stamens occur singly or in clusters. Spherical to oblong fruit is yellow to reddish-purple and 1 inch in diameter.


Habitat: Thickets, woodlands, mountain slopes; plains, and valleys.


Uses: Fruit is edible. Branches used for ceremonies. Roots have been used to make dyes.
